blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Education (DepEd) has issued the guidelines for the distribution of more than 231,000 laptops to public school teachers ahead of its nationwide rollout on Monday, Nov. 9. “We want to ensure these laptops go to teachers who can maximize them most for teaching and learning, while keeping equity at the center by prioritizing teachers who have never received a government- or school-issued laptop,” Education Secretary Sonny Angara said in a statement on Saturday, Nov. 7. According to DepEd, the distribution will begin in schools that are first time recipients of the Laptops for Teachers component […]...
